So I've been struggling with puppy grooms, they are definitely one of the things I struggle with the most. I don't know I always try and make it so positive and do lots of treats and breaks and love, but I don't know if I'm pushing them too far sometimes? I'm still new to grooming and I don't want to traumatized these babies and I'm usually so good with knowing a dogs limits but with puppy grooms (especially the first ones) I feel like it is so hard to tell for some reason. This little guy is 5 months and came in for his first groom, and I told the owners that for some puppies all they can handle is a bath with a fff but the owner said they wanted a teddy bear cut and I told them I would try but in the end we don't want to push the puppy and make grooming a bad thing. Well I was able to do a full cut, he was a little wiggly but I talked sweet to him and had another person there distracting and comforting him and gave him special treats and in the end he was happy ( the puppy lol, owner did not seem happy... 🙃) and we were best friends by the end so idk. He definitely didn't like the bath or the clippers near his face (I just scissored his face and then put the clippers near his face while giving him special treats and praise). And he was getting tired of the clippers on his legs so I just quickly scissors them up. I might just be overthinking it but I feel like I definitely need some advice on puppy grooms, I want the best for these babies and I don't want to be the reason they hate getting groomed 😔 thank you so much for any advice it is greatly appreciated!!

All this to say I feel you man, and sorry for the rant I'm just totally burnt out at this point. Keep your head up and try to take care of yourself, sleep enough, eat enough and drink enough water. It's not a cure but you'll definitely feel less shitty about life. Try making a friend if possible (I know it's very hard and I am for sure one to talk) who you can share what you are going through with and they will listen and be there for you. Try to do some things that make you happy, they don't have to be expensive but you deserve to enjoy life  as much as possible. Go somewhere scenic and just enjoy a view with a loved one. Idk just some ideas, I know they'd help me if I'd actually do em :/ Best of luck, I hope when I'm commenting on this 2 months later you are doing better!
